rq5_perf.request_costs: estimate: per-object request profile measured against MinIO through a counting proxy (dry run) x the cloud object counts

measurement.throughput: committed (and archived) payload bytes between the first observation at >= 10% and at >= 90% of the topic, divided by the time between them (broker clock)
measurement.latency: per record: max(first LIST that shows an intact object holding it, first committed-offset poll beyond it) - produce() call time; all on the broker clock
measurement.recovery: kill at >= kill_at of the records committed; times from SIGKILL
